newsitem.title: CANADA: NY Fed's McDonough sees U.S. economy slowing.
newsitem.headline: NY Fed's McDonough sees U.S. economy slowing.

text.p: New York Federal Reserve Bank President William McDonough on Friday said that second quarter economic information pointed to a slowdown in the U.S. economy.
"The data thus far in the second quarter indicates that the economy is slowing down," McDonough told reporters after a speech in Toronto at the World Forex Conference.
McDonough declined to comment on the level of the U.S. dollar versus the yen after being pressed by reporters.
"I am a great believer in floating exchange rates," was all McDonough would say.
